prompts.king:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production character sprite atlas for Omega Omarchy, named The Omarch King.
Reference image 1 supplies the King's identity, facial features, short dark hair, angular violet-and-gold crown, black armor with gold circuit engraving and purple shoulders. Reference image 2 supplies ONLY the game's stylized polished 3D figurine proportions and readable side-view rendering, not its face, hair or outfit. Render the King in that game's style, with an athletic practical lower-body outfit: black fitted armored trousers, sturdy black boots with gold trims, short purple shoulder mantle that does not obscure legs.
Create a strict evenly spaced FIVE COLUMN by FOUR ROW atlas, exactly 20 isolated poses, each wholly inside its own equal cell, centered with at least 12% transparent padding. Overall landscape 5:4 composition, large high-resolution sprite sheet. True transparent RGBA background, NO painted checkerboard, NO floor, shadows, scenery, grid lines, letters, labels or extra people. Clean isolated alpha edges. Same crown, face, armor, body proportions and lighting in every cell. Compact crown fitting the silhouette; no detached accessories.
Reading left-to-right, top-to-bottom, cells are:
ROW 1: idle standing facing RIGHT in strict profile; walk contact A facing RIGHT left leg forward/right back; walk passing A facing RIGHT left leg planted/right knee passing; walk contact B facing RIGHT right leg forward/left back; walk passing B facing RIGHT right leg planted/left knee passing.
ROW 2: jumping up facing RIGHT knees lifted; rear-view ladder climb left hand up/right knee raised; rear-view climb passing shoulders level; rear-view ladder climb right hand up/left knee raised; rear-view climb opposite passing.
ROW 3: grounded forward martial kick facing RIGHT; airborne forward kick facing RIGHT; overhand throw facing RIGHT with EMPTY hand (no projectile); low seated feet-first ground slide facing RIGHT with hand braced behind; full-body rear idle standing with back to camera.
ROW 4: frontal head-and-shoulders portrait including whole crown; captured pose sitting slumped upright facing RIGHT, arms at sides, no chair or restraints; full-body reclining unconscious horizontal facing RIGHT with head at LEFT and feet at RIGHT, no bed or machine; dedicated rear head-and-shoulders closeup for over-the-shoulder view, facing away, no monitor; full-body rear-view leaping away with arms slightly spread and feet visible.
Ensure distinct alternating walk and climb contacts. Keep all whole figures INCLUDING crowns, hands and boots within their cells. This is a game sprite atlas, not a poster.
